basic_details.job_title: Sivasagar District Administration Revenue Sheristadar Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Office of the District Commissioner, Sivasagar, Government of Assam, has released the Revenue Sheristadar Recruitment 2026 notification under Advertisement No. Ecf.No:195372/6. The recruitment is for the post of Revenue Sheristadar in the Sivasagar District Administration, Assam.

important_dates.notification date: 07-10-2026 (Govt. Letter No. E-843290/6) / As on signed
important_dates.last_date_to_apply: Within 30 days from the date of publishing (06 November 2026)

qualification.details: Eligibility Conditions: | The candidate must have served at least 15 (fifteen) years in any of the District Commissioners' establishments in Assam. Must possess experience of different branches in general and of the Revenue branch in particular.

selection_process: Selection will be done by the Government in the General Administration Department as per "The Assam Ministerial District Establishment Service Rules
1967" and the Assam Ministerial District Establishment Service (Amendment) Rules

content_sections.heading: Sivasagar District Administration Revenue Sheristadar at a Glance

rows.details: Office of the District Commissioner, Sivasagar, Government of Assam
Pay Band Rs 22,000–97,000, Grade Pay Rs 11,500/- per month plus other allowances
Must have served at least 15 years in any District Commissioners' establishment in Assam
Within 30 days from the date of publishing (06 November 2026)

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted through proper channel with service particulars to the District Commissioner, Sivasagar. Postal Address: Office of the District Commissioner, Sivasagar, Government of Assam

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Eligibility Conditions: The candidate must have served at least 15 (fifteen) years in any of the District Commissioners' establishments in Assam. Must possess experience of different branches in general and of the Revenue branch in particular.

rows.pay: Pay Band Rs 22,000–97,000, Grade Pay Rs 11,500/- per month plus other allowances

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Attested copies of certificates stating age, educational qualification, present and permanent address, and experience in different branches A copy of recent passport size photograph Annual Confidential Reports of the last 5 (five) consecutive years

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection will be done by the Government in the General Administration Department as per "The Assam Ministerial District Establishment Service Rules, 1967" and the Assam Ministerial District Establishment Service (Amendment) Rules, 1999.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post available in Sivasagar District Administration Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The available post is Revenue Sheristadar in the amalgamated establishment of the District Commissioner, Sivasagar.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Revenue Sheristadar post?
faq.answer: The total number of vacancies is not stated in the notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications is 06 November 2026 (within 30 days from the date of publishing).

faq.question: Q4. What is the required service experience to apply?
faq.answer: Candidates must have served at least 15 years in any of the District Commissioners' establishments in Assam with experience in different branches, particularly the Revenue branch.

faq.question: Q5. What is the pay scale for the Revenue Sheristadar post?
faq.answer: The post carries a Pay Band of Rs 22,000–97,000 with a Grade Pay of Rs 11,500/- per month plus other allowances under the Assam Services (ROP) Rules, 2017.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee mentioned in the notification?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How should candidates submit their applications?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted through proper channel with service particulars to the District Commissioner, Sivasagar.

faq.question: Q8. What documents must be attached with the application?
faq.answer: Candidates must attach attested copies of certificates for age, education, address, and branch experience, a recent passport size photograph, and Annual Confidential Reports of the last 5 consecutive years.

faq.question: Q9. Who handles the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Selection is conducted by the Government in the General Administration Department under the Assam Ministerial District Establishment Service Rules, 1967 and its 1999 Amendment.
